[[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] personal [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]], led a '''raid''' on a [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] [[Unidentified Sakiyan smuggling ring|ring]] based in [[Syvris shadowport]] after uncovering evidence that the smugglers were running supplies for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during an earlier [[Raid on the Ulkantha asteroids|raid]] on the [[Ulkantha asteroids]]. The raid nearly obliterated [[Syvris/Legends|Syvris]], and important members of the organization were captured.<ref name="TEGtW" />
